channel.title: Must-Reads
channel.description: Three curated original articles a day

item.title: As AI closed in on 'Unique Games' proof, researchers raced to beat the machines (Quanta Magazine)
item.description: The mathematics behind today's breakthrough item: what the 2-to-1 and 4-to-1 conjectures say, how the human proof works, and how the AI release changed the race.

item.title: He wants AI benchmarking to be a science, not a dark art (Quanta Magazine)
item.description: Moritz Hardt on why model rankings used to be reliable even when scores weren't, why LLMs broke that, and his proposed fix of giving every model the same preparation before it is tested.

item.title: US-Iran stalemate: What are Trump's next military options? (Al Jazeera)
item.description: A structured look at the escalation ladder after the midterms, from keeping the blockade to strikes or Kharg Island, and what each would cost in munitions and Gulf retaliation.

item.title: US and Iran both claim control of the Strait of Hormuz (Al Jazeera)
item.description: The clearest single picture of the shipping war that is setting oil prices this autumn.

item.title: Tracing the origins of the NIST elliptic-curve seeds (Anthropic Research)
item.description: A decades-old cryptography mystery, how the seeds behind standard elliptic curves were chosen, and how an AI model solved most of it.

item.title: Designing efficient quantum circuits with Claude (Anthropic Research)
item.description: Real algorithmic content (reversible gcd, Berlekamp-Massey) and a template for how AI-plus-verifier research will work.
